answer: 81% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. Because the walnut burn is written down at the haven settlement, the ivory audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
